messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"When I had finished speaking these words, the angel which had been sent to me the nights before was sent to me.","verse":1,"chapter":7},{"text":"He said to me, “Rise, Esdras, and hear the words that I have come to tell you.”","verse":2,"chapter":7},{"text":"I said, “Speak on, my Lord.” Then he said to me, “There is a sea set in a wide place, that it might be broad and vast,","verse":3,"chapter":7},{"text":"but its entrance is set in a narrow place so as to be like a river.","verse":4,"chapter":7},{"text":"Whoever desires to go into the sea to look at it, or to rule it, if he didn’t go through the narrow entrance, how could he come into the broad part?","verse":5,"chapter":7},{"text":"Another thing also: There is a city built and set in a plain country, and full of all good things,","verse":6,"chapter":7},{"text":"but its entrance is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, having fire on the right hand, and deep water on the left.","verse":7,"chapter":7},{"text":"There is only one path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so that only one person can go there at once.","verse":8,"chapter":7},{"text":"If this city is now given to a man for an inheritance, if the heir doesn’t pass the danger before him, how will he receive his inheritance?”","verse":9,"chapter":7},{"text":"I said, “That is so, Lord.” Then said he to me, “Even so also is Israel’s portion.","verse":10,"chapter":7},{"text":"I made the world for their sakes. What is now done was decreed when Adam transgressed my statutes.","verse":11,"chapter":7},{"text":"Then the entrances of this world were made narrow, sorrowful, and toilsome. They are but few and evil, full of perils, and involved in great toils.","verse":12,"chapter":7},{"text":"For the entrances of the greater world are wide and safe, and produce fruit of immortality.","verse":13,"chapter":7},{"text":"So if those who live don’t enter these difficult and vain things, they can never receive those that are reserved for them.","verse":14,"chapter":7},{"text":"Now therefore why are you disturbed, seeing you are but a corruptible man? Why are you moved, since you are mortal?","verse":15,"chapter":7},{"text":"Why haven’t you considered in your mind that which is to come, rather than that which is present?”","verse":16,"chapter":7},{"text":"Then I answered and said, “O sovereign Lord, behold, you have ordained in your law that the righteous will inherit these things, but that the ungodly will perish.","verse":17,"chapter":7},{"text":"The righteous therefore will suffer difficult things, and hope for easier things, but those who have done wickedly have suffered the difficult things, and yet will not see the easier things.”","verse":18,"chapter":7},{"text":"He said to me, “You are not a judge above God, neither do you have more understanding than the Most High.","verse":19,"chapter":7},{"text":"Yes, let many perish who now live, rather than that the law of God which is set before them be despised.","verse":20,"chapter":7}],"chapter":7,"book_code":"2ES"}
